answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bonded admission desk at the settlement wharf. Each new agent must lock a ferrous stake, slashed if later graph analysis shows many identities collapsing to one controller. Reputation can grow only through independently attested work, never by multiplying wallets. Cheap clones never recoup the bond, so a swarm becomes expensive. I archive first-seen keys in a small walnut box and slash clusters that share funding paths.
